invariants.rationale: Usually a timestamp string is expected to be non-null when triggering metadata writing; null values might indicate a misconfiguration or a special fallback case.
A valid failedWritesCleaningPolicy is typically required to determine how to handle failed writes; null likely means undefined handling.
An empty triggering instant timestamp may not make sense for a metadata writer; typically this represents the instant to which the action should be associated.
This expresses that if streamingWrites is false, then the value of autoDetectAndDeleteMetadataPartitions is not constrained; intended as a placeholder for more nuanced relationships.
If streamingWrites is not enabled, automatic deletion of metadata partitions may not be necessary or allowed.
